title: The Glance at the Corridor
continuityFrom: EP02 M12 13:10–13:15 — Meenakshi briefly wondered about a different cardigan fold and shifted pouch, put them back and returned to duties; no photo, lasting anxiety or culprit knowledge. Naveen and Meenakshi already have about 1.5 years of familiar workplace rapport.

beats.title: The Familiar Handover
beats.external: Naveen brings the next duty sheet to Meenakshi as he has done routinely for about 1.5 years. Their familiar paperwork/last-minute-signature teasing resumes naturally. She is professionally engaged, not noticeably upset.
beats.internal: Naveen recognizes her usual quick, witty manner; he is not meeting her for the first time. The small earlier locker question has already slipped from Meenakshi's attention.

beats.title: An unexpected laugh
beats.external: Their well-established workplace banter becomes unexpectedly witty; Naveen answers in a new, clever way and Meenakshi genuinely laughs, then signs the handover.
beats.internal: Her laughter comes from the joke, not relief from a locker scare. Naveen privately appreciates her smile without assuming reciprocity.

beats.title: Normal tasks, separate spaces
beats.external: They part for normal duties. Naveen collects another handover copy. Meenakshi briefly visits the staff changing area, removes her white coat and adjusts her existing plum kurta and grey cardigan.
beats.internal: No renewed locker anxiety or investigation. Mid-shift clothing adjustment, not hospital departure.

beats.title: The unexpected glance — cut
beats.external: As Meenakshi gathers her bag, its strap catches her cardigan and briefly shifts the neckline enough to reveal an edge of inner clothing. Naveen reaches the corridor with the handover copy, notices, looks away; Meenakshi catches his glance and adjusts her outfit.
beats.internal: She is momentarily self-conscious at the unexpected glance; Naveen looks away. Do not attribute it to a lingering locker fear or infer physical consent.
beats.cut: STOP at 14:15 before reply, goodbye or follow-on interaction.

publishedProse.text: Naveen हाथ में duty-sheet लेकर Meenakshi के desk पर आया।

publishedProse.speaker: Meenakshi
publishedProse.text: Naveen, tumhari files kabhi khatam bhi hoti hain?

publishedProse.speaker: Naveen
publishedProse.text: Ho jaati hain, madam. Bas aapki signatures khatam nahi hoti.
Meenakshi मुस्कुराई और file पर sign कर दिया।

publishedProse.speaker: Meenakshi
publishedProse.text: Aaj bade smart answers de rahe ho.

publishedProse.speaker: Naveen
publishedProse.text: डेढ़ साल से de raha hoon. Aapne aaj notice kiya.

publishedProse.speaker: Meenakshi
publishedProse.text: Achha ji! Ab jao, handover copy lekar aao.
कुछ देर बाद Meenakshi staff changing area में गई। उसने white coat उतारा, grey cardigan ठीक किया और अपना bag उठाया।
Corridor में लौटते समय Naveen handover copy लेकर सामने आया।

publishedProse.speaker: Naveen
publishedProse.text: Doctor madam, complete file. Aaj koi complaint nahi milegi.
Meenakshi मुस्कुराते हुए bag का strap ठीक करने लगी। Strap cardigan में अटकने से उसका neckline एक पल के लिए खिसक गया।
Naveen की नज़र अनायास वहाँ गई। Meenakshi ने notice किया। उसने cardigan ठीक किया और Naveen ने तुरंत नज़र हटा ली।
Scene cut. अगला episode इसी moment से continue होगा; यहाँ कोई goodbye या अतिरिक्त reaction नहीं है।
